::: {.bio-text}

I am an Assistant Professor at [University College London's Computer Science department](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/computer-science/research/research-groups/financial-computing-and-analytics), a Research Scientist at [Google DeepMind](https://deepmind.google/), and a visiting fellow at the Growth Lab at the [Harvard Kennedy School](https://growthlab.hks.harvard.edu). I was [JSMF](https://www.jsmf.org/) Fellow at the [Complexity Science Hub](https://www.csh.ac.at/). I did my PhD in Mathematics at the Institute for New Economic Thinking at the Oxford Martin School, [University of Oxford](https://www.inet.ox.ac.uk).

My research draws from Machine Learning (ML), Large Language Models (LLMs), Networks, and Agent-Based Modelling (ABMs) to study the economic impacts of the net-zero transition, the Covid-19 pandemic, and (Gen)AI.

*I don't currently have any funded PhD studentships available. If that changes, I'll announce it here.*
